status: Planned one CPU-only training/development decoder; not executed or selected.
motivation: V5 exact calibration improves the continuous profile but fails16/64 full labels. Its identity mapping from calibration to evaluation assumes transfer without learning it. Test whether a fixed, training-only linear map can correct systematic profile transfer.
scope: Learned base-model-assisted functional decoder, not a trained LoRAcle checkpoint. Even if it passes development, it cannot be called a weights-only LoRAcle improvement or establish original goal completion without untouched generalization and scope review.
inputs: Use only the original32-dimensional centered exact calibration profiles from audited v5. No source task label, update training text, evaluation prompts or targets at inference. Original physical magnitude is retained.
training: Original272 training records only:256 actual and16zero. Targets are their separately measured32-dimensional centered evaluation loss profiles, never training-task labels. Fixed ridge kernel X@X.T; penalty .01 times mean squared feature norm over actual training updates, same rule as v3. No intercept, normalization, hyperparameter search, new data or GPU work. Zero maps exactly to zero.
prediction: Use fixed original argmax across32 patterns and no-change if profile span<.02. No clipping, margin filtering, fitted posthoc scale or class-prior substitution. Predict both own and exactly scored norm-matched shuffled input profiles from v5.
evaluation: All64 actual development updates plus8zeros. Compare every v5 baseline and own/shuffled model. All original full-category gates and2000 paired cluster bootstrap preserved. Report profiles, all groups, all cases and uncertainty. Model and predictions lock before analysis joins development targets. Prior familiarity with development is explicit; this is not prospective confirmation.
decision: If this single fixed model fails, do not retune it on development or open reserved/fresh tests. Preserve complete failure and stop this exact-calibration transfer branch. If it passes, independently audit the fit and inference; only a separately frozen verified held-out implementation could test generalization. Original v5 held-out selection cannot be used unchanged.
unchanged_reserved_tests: Neither original reserved nor fresh confirmation grid is collected or evaluated. All previous negative results remain.
